summary: This Form 6-K filed by Vesta Real Estate Corporation, S.A.B. de C.V. reports resolutions from an Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting held on April 22, 2026. The meeting approved routine items: the CEO's annual report, the board's annual report, committee reports (audit, corporate practices, investment, ethics, debt/equity, ESG), tax compliance, and audited consolidated financial statements for fiscal year 2025, including allocation to legal reserve. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change—is present. The filing is a standard annual meeting summary under Mexican law, equivalent to a routine U.S. proxy statement or annual report filing. No deal terms apply.
